reason: Instagram already fills my room and it costs me nothing. I'd maybe let them list me for free since it costs nothing, but I'm not paying for a platform until I see real people using it.
objection: I've paid for apps and promo platforms that brought nobody. 500 people on a waitlist isn't customers walking in my door, and I don't see why I'd pay when Instagram works.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the app past 2,000 active users in my city and a few venues like mine showing me real people coming through because of it, with the free month guarantee actually honoured.
